Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Yadvendra Singh Hon'ble Mrs. Saroj Yadav,J.

The present bail application has been filed on behalf of the accused/ applicant in Case Crime No.174 of 2019, under Sections 376, 354Kha, 506 of I.P.C. and 3/4 of POCSO Act, Police Station Sikandar Pur Vaishya, District Kasganj with the prayer to enlarge him on bail.
Heard Shri Vipin Kumar, learned counsel for the accused/applicant, Shri Shyam Babu, learned Brief Holder for the State-respondent and perused the record.
Learned counsel for the accused applicant submitted that the accused applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the crime due to property dispute.
The F.I.R. has been lodged after a considerable delay of seven days and no plausible explanation is there, for such delay.
In the medical examination, no injury of any kind either internal or external has been found on the body of the victim.
The applicant is in jail since 02.10.2019.
He has no criminal history as has been mentioned in the para 24 of the affidavit filed in support of the bail application.
Hence, the accused applicant should be enlarged on bail.

sentences.text: The accused applicant has committed rape upon the victim.
Hence, he should not be enlarged on bail.
Considered the rival submissions made by the parties' counsel and perused the material available on record.

It transpires from the record that though the allegation of rape by the accused applicant is there but in the medical examination, no injury of any kind either internal or external has been found on the person of the victim.
The accused applicant is in jail since 02.10.2019.
Considering all the facts and circumstances of the case as mentioned above, without commenting on merits of the case, it appears just to enlarge the accused applicant on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application filed on behalf of applicant is allowed.

Let the applicant Mulayam involved in Case Crime No.174 of 2019 (supra) be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions;
(i) The applicant shall file an undertaking to the effect that he shall not seek any adjournment on the dates fixed for evidence when the witnesses are present in court.

In case of default of this condition,
it shall be open for the trial court to treat it as abuse of liberty of bail and pass orders in accordance with law.
(ii) The applicant shall remain present before the trial court on each date fixed, either personally or through his counsel.
In case of his absence, without sufficient cause, the trial court may proceed against his under Section 229-A of the Indian Penal Code.

(iii) In case, the applicant misuses the liberty of bail during trial and in order to secure his presence proclamation under Section 82 Cr.P.C. is issued and the applicant fails to appear before the court on the date fixed in such proclamation, then, the trial court shall initiate proceedings against his, in accordance with law, under Section 174-A of the Indian Penal Code.

(iv) The applicant shall remain present, in person, before the trial court on the dates fixed for (i)
opening of the case, (ii) framing of charge and (iii) recording of statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C.
If in the opinion of the trial court absence of the applicant is deliberate or without sufficient cause,
then it shall be open for the trial court to treat such default as abuse of liberty of bail and proceed against his in accordance with law.
(v)The party shall file computer generated copy of such order downloaded from the official website of High Court Allahabad.
(vi) The computer generated copy of such order shall be self attested by the counsel of the party concerned.
